method.repetitions: Three fresh processes per timed backend, alternating order. The RF-DETR pycocotools metric control runs once for correctness.
method.file_time: GT/prediction JSON loading + evaluate + accumulate + summarize; excludes inference and output serialization
method.metric_time: RF-DETR metric construction + batched update + single-process merge + compute; excludes inference, JSON/trace preparation/loading, and output serialization
method.memory: Whole-process peak RSS, including imports, inputs and output serialization
method.concurrency: File and metric batches ran concurrently on separate CPU sets; inference had completed
